name: Shadow Howl grants the party root and snare immunity (#3605)
contract: Shadow Howl 806177 ships two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects in Spell.dbc, both aura 77 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY with BasePoints -1, MiscValue 11 (MECHANIC_SNARE) and MiscValue 7 (MECHANIC_ROOT), TargetA 22 / TargetB 56 (caster-area party/raid), radius index 10 (30 yards), duration index 32 (6 seconds) and RecoveryTime 60000. The native handler is AuraEffect::HandleModMechanicImmunity, and root plus snare immunity is exactly the tooltip's "immunity to movement impairing effects". Frost Nova 122 is the probe: its effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 26 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ROOT and Mechanic 7, so Unit::IsImmunedToSpellEffect must report immunity only while the howl is up. 806177 carries CasterAuraSpell 525031, one of the two Cursed Form markers AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp mirrors onto the real form state, so the caster is given that marker as a fixture.

steps.label: The ally is rootable before the howl
The howl reaches the grouped ally
The ally is immune to the root mechanic while it lasts
The snare immunity carries the shipped amount
